entries.en: OK, bud, you've had your quota for the day.
entries.ro: OK, bă, ai atins cota pentru azi.

entries.en: Au contraire, my friend! Good sake's never done anybody any harm.
entries.ro: Ba nu, prietene! Un sake bun n-a omorât pe nimeni.

entries.en: Japanese have this saying, see. First toast – man drinks the sake. Second toast – sake drinks the sake. Third toast – sake drinks the man.
entries.ro: Japonezii au o vorbă, vezi tu. Primul toast – omul bea sake-ul. Al doilea toast – sake-ul bea sake-ul. Al treilea toast – sake-ul bea omul.

entries.en: Aww, runny bullshit, that. I got a better saying…
entries.ro: Aoleu, vrăjeală ieftină, asta. Am eu una mai bună…

entries.en: First toast – I get the sake. Second toast – you get the sake. Third toast – sake's on the house, yeah?
entries.ro: Primul toast – iau eu sake-ul. Al doilea toast – iei tu sake-ul. Al treilea toast – sake-ul e din partea casei, da?

entries.en: Tyger Claw bar, holmes. Ain't nothin' on the house here.
entries.ro: Bar Tyger Claw, holmes. Aici nu e nimic din partea casei.

entries.en: Tyger Claws...? Err... best be goin', yeah? Ah.
entries.ro: Tyger Claws...? Ăă... mai bine plecăm, da? Ah.
